_readme: Copy to samples.json (gitignored) and edit the paths. A file entry may be a ROOT file, a directory of ROOT files, a glob pattern, or a list of these. Simulation samples need 'clustered' (phase I), 'tracked' (phase II) and 'golden' (phase III); data samples need 'analyzed' (phases I and II) and 'golden' (phase III). Optional per sample: 'label', 'colour', 'marker', 'reco_version' (shown in legends, titles and tables, and recorded in the run information), and for data 'detector' when the name is not NERO, ROSSO or BLU. Add further simulation samples, e.g. an older production, to compare simulation versions with --target.
